hspice_content:
.title TSA SMIC18 calibration; explicit PVT qualification
.temp 125
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.option unwrap ingold=2 post=0 numdgt=8 measdgt=8 method=gear co=132
.param sim_type=0
.param w_n_123=2.02e-05 l_n_123=3.29e-06 w_p_4=3e-05 l_p_4=2.18e-06 w_p_5_8=1.46e-06 l_p_5_8=1.8e-07 w_p_6_7=7.79e-06 l_p_6_7=1.81e-06 w_n_9=5e-07 l_n_9=9.09e-06 w_n_10_11=1.999e-05 l_n_10_11=4.96e-06 w_n_12=1.418e-05 l_n_12=2.44e-06 w_p_13_14=1.95e-06 l_p_13_14=3.42e-06 w_p_15_16=9.6e-06 l_p_15_16=3.8e-07 w_n_17_18=1.814e-05 l_n_17_18=2.1e-07 w_n_19_20=5e-07 l_n_19_20=9.79e-06 w_n_21=4.03e-06 l_n_21=3.9e-07 w_p_22=2.08e-05 l_p_22=5.5e-07
.subckt calibration_core vdd vss vin vip vo ibias
m1 ibias ibias vss vss N18 W=w_n_123 L=l_n_123 M=2
m2 vbp2 ibias vss vss N18 W=w_n_123 L=l_n_123 M=2
m3 vbp1 ibias vss vss N18 W=w_n_123 L=l_n_123 M=2
m4 vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_4 L=l_p_4 M=1
m5 vbp1 ibias net02 vdd P18 W=w_p_5_8 L=l_p_5_8 M=3
m6 net02 vbp1 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_6_7 L=l_p_6_7 M=1
m7 net03 vbp1 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_6_7 L=l_p_6_7 M=1
m8 vbn2 vbp2 net03 vdd P18 W=w_p_5_8 L=l_p_5_8 M=3
m9 vbn2 vbn2 vss vss N18 W=w_n_9 L=l_n_9 M=1
m10 net05 vin net04 vss N18 W=w_n_10_11 L=l_n_10_11 M=5
m11 net06 vip net04 vss N18 W=w_n_10_11 L=l_n_10_11 M=5
m12 net04 ibias vss vss N18 W=w_n_12 L=l_n_12 M=8
m13 net05 vbp1 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_13_14 L=l_p_13_14 M=16
m14 net06 vbp1 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_13_14 L=l_p_13_14 M=16
m15 net07 vbp2 net05 vdd P18 W=w_p_15_16 L=l_p_15_16 M=8
m16 net10 vbp2 net06 vdd P18 W=w_p_15_16 L=l_p_15_16 M=8
m17 net07 vbn2 net08 vss N18 W=w_n_17_18 L=l_n_17_18 M=1
m18 net10 vbn2 net09 vss N18 W=w_n_17_18 L=l_n_17_18 M=1
m19 net08 net07 vss vss N18 W=w_n_19_20 L=l_n_19_20 M=16
m20 net09 net07 vss vss N18 W=w_n_19_20 L=l_n_19_20 M=32
m21 vo net10 vss vss N18 W=w_n_21 L=l_n_21 M=40
m22 vo vbp1 vdd vdd P18 W=w_p_22 L=l_p_22 M=4
cc net10 net11 3.25e-13
r1 net11 vo 1500
.ends calibration_core
XDUT vdd 0 vin vip vo ibias calibration_core
IBIAS0 vdd ibias DC 2e-05
.if (sim_type==0)
VDD vdd 0 DC 1.8
CLOAD vo 0 1e-11
VCMLOAD load_reference 0 0.9
RLOAD vo load_reference 1000
VIP vip 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
LSERVO vo vin 1e12
CSERVO vin 0 1e12
.dc VDD 1.8 1.8 .01
.meas dc test_dc_error find par('abs(v(vo)-0.9)') at=1.8
.meas dc test_supply_current find par('-i(VDD)') at=1.8
.ac dec 60 1 1e9
.print ac vr(vo) vi(vo)
.noise v(vo) VIP
.meas ac test_noise find inoise at=1e3
.meas ac test_onoise find onoise at=1e3
.meas ac test_noise_gain find vm(vo) at=1e3
.meas ac test_gain find vdb(vo) at=1
.meas ac test_ugb find par('hertz') when vdb(vo)=0 cross=1
.meas ac test_pm find par('vp(vo)+180') when vdb(vo)=0 cross=1
.meas ac test_gm find par('-vdb(vo)') when vp(vo)=-180 cross=1
.endif
.if (sim_type==1)
VDD vdd 0 DC 1.8 AC 1
VIP vip 0 DC 0.9
VFB vin vo 0
.dc VDD 1.8 1.8 .01
.meas dc test_iq find par('-i(VDD)') at=1.8
.meas dc test_power find par('-i(VDD)*1.8') at=1.8
.ac lin 1 1000 1000
.meas ac test_psrr find par('-vdb(vo)') at=1000
.endif
.if (sim_type==2)
VDD vdd 0 DC 1.8
VFB vin vo 0
CLOAD vo 0 1e-11
RLOAD vo 0 2000
VIP vip 0 PULSE(1.4 0.4 1n 1p 1p 10u 20u)
.tran 10n 19.5u
.meas tran test_rise trig v(vo) val=0.7 rise=1 targ v(vo) val=1.1 rise=1 from=10u to=19u
.meas tran test_fall trig v(vo) val=1.1 fall=1 targ v(vo) val=0.7 fall=1 from=0u to=9u
.meas tran test_sr_p param='0.4/test_rise'
.meas tran test_sr_n param='0.4/test_fall'
.endif
.if (sim_type==3)
VDD vdd 0 DC 1.8
VFB vin vo 0
CLOAD vo 0 1e-11
VIP vip 0 PULSE(0.9 0.91 2u 20n 20n 8u 16u)
.tran 10n 12u
.meas tran test_step_error max par('abs(v(vo)-v(vip))') from=7u to=9u
.endif
.alter
.temp 125
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=1
.alter
.temp 125
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=2
.alter
.temp 125
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=3
.alter
.temp -40
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=0
.alter
.temp -40
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=1
.alter
.temp -40
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=2
.alter
.temp -40
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" SS
.param sim_type=3
.alter
.temp 125
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=0
.alter
.temp 125
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=1
.alter
.temp 125
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=2
.alter
.temp 125
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=3
.alter
.temp -40
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=0
.alter
.temp -40
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=1
.alter
.temp -40
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=2
.alter
.temp -40
.del lib 1 SS
.lib "./hsp_model/smic18_hsp_model/ms018_v1p7.lib" FF
.param sim_type=3
.end
